name: Aerosmith

whyMatters.en: Boston hard-rock band formed in 1970. Steven Tyler’s vocals, Joe Perry’s lead guitar, and a funk-leaning rhythm section define the 1970s catalog; Dream On and Walk This Way remain the main FM reference points.
whyMatters.zh: 波士顿硬摇滚乐队，1970 年成立。Steven Tyler 的人声、Joe Perry 的主音吉他，以及偏 funk 的节奏组，构成 1970 年代代表声音；Dream On 与 Walk This Way 是主要的 FM 参照曲。

lyricQuotes: Dream on / Dream on / Dream until your dreams come true
Walk this way / Talk this way

shortBio.en: Boston hard rock, 1970–. Dream On and Walk This Way mark the 1970s radio peak; Crazy is the best-known 1990s MTV ballad.
shortBio.zh: 波士顿硬摇滚，1970 年至今。Dream On 与 Walk This Way 是 1970 年代电台高峰；Crazy 是 1990 年代 MTV 期最知名的谣曲。

body.en:
Aerosmith formed in Boston in 1970. The classic five—Steven Tyler, Joe Perry, Brad Whitford, Tom Hamilton, and Joey Kramer—built a blues-based hard-rock sound with syncopated riffs and Tyler’s high vocal delivery. Toys in the Attic (1975) and Rocks (1976) are the core 1970s albums; Walk This Way and Sweet Emotion come from that stretch. Dream On, from the 1973 debut, is an early piano ballad that builds into a full-band climax.

Joe Perry left in 1979 and returned in 1984. Permanent Vacation (1987), Pump (1989), and Get a Grip (1993) restored mainstream sales, often with outside co-writers such as Desmond Child. Crazy (1993) was a major MTV-era single. Run-DMC’s 1986 remake of Walk This Way brought the original riff into hip-hop radio.
body.zh:
Aerosmith 于 1970 年在波士顿成立。经典五人编制——Steven Tyler、Joe Perry、Brad Whitford、Tom Hamilton 与 Joey Kramer——以蓝调底色的硬摇滚、切分 riff 和 Tyler 的高音演唱建立声音。Toys in the Attic（1975）与 Rocks（1976）是 1970 年代核心专辑；Walk This Way 与 Sweet Emotion 出自这一时期。1973 年首张专辑中的 Dream On 是早期钢琴谣曲，后半段推到全乐队高潮。

Joe Perry 于 1979 年离队，1984 年回归。Permanent Vacation（1987）、Pump（1989）与 Get a Grip（1993）恢复了主流销量，常与 Desmond Child 等外部写手合作。Crazy（1993）是 MTV 期重要单曲。Run-DMC 1986 年翻唱 Walk This Way，把原曲 riff 带进 hip-hop 电台。

note.zh: 钢琴谣曲推到叠和声高潮；早期美国 FM power ballad 参照。

note.en: Syncopated guitar riff and Tyler vocal; from Toys in the Attic.
note.zh: 切分吉他 riff 与 Tyler 人声；出自 Toys in the Attic。

note.en: Power ballad from Get a Grip; major MTV-era single.
note.zh: 出自 Get a Grip 的 power ballad；MTV 期重要单曲。

title.zh: 带切分 riff 的蓝调硬摇滚

body.en:
Aerosmith’s 1970s sound draws on Stones-style blues rock and louder hard-rock volume, then writes American riffs over Kramer’s drum pocket and Perry’s Les Paul tone.

Dream On shows ballad dynamics; Walk This Way shows syncopation that worked on FM radio.

Toys in the Attic and Rocks remain the strongest studio documents of that approach.
body.zh:
Aerosmith 1970 年代的声音接近 Stones 式蓝调摇滚与更大的硬摇滚音量，再以 Kramer 的鼓点口袋拍和 Perry 的 Les Paul 音色写美国 riff。

Dream On 展示谣曲动态；Walk This Way 展示能在 FM 电台站住的切分写法。

Toys in the Attic 与 Rocks 仍是这套写法最强的录音室文献。

body.en:
Tyler, Perry, Whitford, Hamilton, and Kramer form the durable core. Perry left from 1979 to 1984; Jimmy Crespo played guitar on Rock in a Hard Place (1982).

After the reunion, Permanent Vacation and later albums restored chart presence. MTV-era writing often paired Tyler and Perry with outside hit co-writers.

Stage identity stayed centered on Tyler and Perry with the same rhythm section.
body.zh:
Tyler、Perry、Whitford、Hamilton 与 Kramer 构成长期核心。Perry 在 1979–1984 年离队；Jimmy Crespo 在 Rock in a Hard Place（1982）担任吉他。

重聚后，Permanent Vacation 及后续专辑恢复了榜单表现。MTV 期写作常由 Tyler、Perry 与外部热单写手合作。

舞台身份仍以 Tyler 与 Perry 及同一节奏组为中心。

title.en: US hard rock and the Walk This Way remake
title.zh: 美国硬摇滚与 Walk This Way 翻唱

body.en:
Guns N’ Roses and other 1980s US hard-rock acts have cited Aerosmith’s swagger and riff writing. Run-DMC’s 1986 remake made Walk This Way a widely heard cross-genre track.

Crazy and I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing show the ballad side of the same catalog.

Their lasting place is in 1970s–90s US FM hard rock, more than British metal schools.
body.zh:
Guns N’ Roses 与其他 1980 年代美国硬摇滚乐队曾引用 Aerosmith 的姿态与 riff 写法。Run-DMC 1986 年翻唱让 Walk This Way 成为跨类型广为收听的曲目。

Crazy 与 I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing 展示同一目录的谣曲一面。

他们的长期位置在 1970–90 年代美国 FM 硬摇滚，多于英国金属谱系。
